summary: Server-rendered Google Flights fallback results must obey requested stop limits for both directions, even when the returned page includes broader itineraries.
reason: The tfs URL encodes a stop limit, but its rendered payload can still include connecting flights. Without a parsed-leg backstop, a non_stop query can silently return connections.
validated_outcome: Captured mixed-itinerary HTML and per-direction regression tests pass; go test ./..., go build ./..., go vet ./..., and verify-skill all pass.
